يعرنكسون (form IIIq)
# يَعْرَنْكِسُونَ (yaʕrankisūna) /jaʕ.ran.ki.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# يُعْرَنْكَسُونَ (yuʕrankasūna) /juʕ.ran.ka.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
